rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've swept your kitchen. Anything else before I go?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just sit down. You're my guest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The chair could use a polish first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I invited you for company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll talk while I polish. Two reasons to invite me again.

card.title: Useful Enough to Stay
card.instruction: Make yourself constantly useful and read each response as evidence of whether you still belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can I organise the pens before my shift ends?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've finished. Go home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's tomorrow's pens to consider.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'd keep you even without the pens.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. I'll label a drawer for that promise.

card.title: Useful Enough to Stay
card.instruction: Make yourself constantly useful and read each response as evidence of whether you still belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Notice anything about the kitchen? Start with the oven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It looks clean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Four hours clean. The shelf has a history.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thank you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you say it facing the oven? We worked together.

card.title: Notice the Effort
card.instruction: Make your invisible labor visible through pointed reminders, strategic sighs, and opportunities for appreciation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put the empty detergent bottle beside your dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A small memorial to the laundry I did today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thanks for doing it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're welcome. The folded towels are accepting visitors.

card.title: Notice the Effort
card.instruction: Make your invisible labor visible through pointed reminders, strategic sighs, and opportunities for appreciation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tea, then shoes, then keys. You've touched the keys early.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now we'll need to restart the tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I hold the keys while it boils?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do you want to find out why we have an order?

card.title: Don’t Break the Routine
card.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We always open the curtains before feeding the cat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cat's hungry now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The curtains establish morning.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's midday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We've already confused the cat enough.

card.title: Don’t Break the Routine
card.instruction: Protect a familiar routine as though changing one step would invite chaos into everything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed two torches for the picnic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're going at noon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In case noon runs late.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can use our phones.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I've packed chargers for your backup torches.

card.title: The Contingency Person
card.instruction: Meet every ordinary problem with a backup plan, emergency supply, or warning about what could happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The spare tyre's ready. Where's the spare jack?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's already a jack.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when that breaks?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll call for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On which of the two phones I've packed?

card.title: The Contingency Person
card.instruction: Meet every ordinary problem with a backup plan, emergency supply, or warning about what could happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shopping bag split. We can sort dinner right here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on the pavement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Outdoor cooking class. First lesson: tomatoes roll.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bread's wet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We were overdue a soup night.

card.title: Productive Little Disaster
card.instruction: Treat every mistake or delay as a delightful chance to improve the plan, bond, or discover something better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The plumber's cancelled. We've got a free afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sink still leaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's move lunch into the garden.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's raining.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. We won't hear the sink.

card.title: Productive Little Disaster
card.instruction: Treat every mistake or delay as a delightful chance to improve the plan, bond, or discover something better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Confetti sounds lovely. Who's vacuuming it on Monday?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we enjoy the wedding first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Name the vacuum operator and I'm emotionally available.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll do it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Now, glitter: different attachment, same question.

card.title: Who’s Cleaning This Up?
card.instruction: Treat every idea according to the work, cost, cleanup, and follow-through it will create.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You want three extra tables at the party. Who carries them home?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can borrow a van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who returns the van?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You think of everything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's why I'm asking who pays the deposit.

card.title: Who’s Cleaning This Up?
card.instruction: Treat every idea according to the work, cost, cleanup, and follow-through it will create.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding cake's lovely, except that leaning cherry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've got two hundred guests waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then two hundred people might see it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The icing's melting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hold the cake level. The cherry's under enough pressure.

card.title: One Tiny Imperfection
card.instruction: Choose one tiny imperfection and let it steadily outweigh every larger concern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've sold the house. But the photo frame's crooked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're handing over the keys now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not with the frame announcing our standards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's their frame.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we should disclose it before completion.

card.title: One Tiny Imperfection
card.instruction: Choose one tiny imperfection and let it steadily outweigh every larger concern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The printer needs a cable. Of course the wireless printer needs a cable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only for setup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And setup needs a password. Does the password need a cable?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's printed underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The final step is moving the entire desk.

card.title: Nothing Is Ever Simple
card.instruction: Interpret each new complication as proof that ordinary tasks are secretly designed to become impossible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I bought a replacement bulb. It needs a different fitting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's an adapter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the adapter has an adapter, I assume?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can order it online.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. A lighting repair that now requires an account.

card.title: Nothing Is Ever Simple
card.instruction: Interpret each new complication as proof that ordinary tasks are secretly designed to become impossible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll paint the hall green. That is my ruling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was thinking blue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your appeal has been received.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It wasn't an appeal. It was an opinion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it has no standing against the ruling.

card.title: The Final Word
card.instruction: Treat every opinion you offer as a ruling and every continued discussion as an appeal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've decided we order soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're choosing our own lunches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An interesting challenge to jurisdiction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll have a sandwich.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Noted. The soup ruling remains on the record.

card.title: The Final Word
card.instruction: Treat every opinion you offer as a ruling and every continued discussion as an appeal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All deliveries use my entrance from now on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who appointed you building supervisor?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can be flexible about the entrance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Is that badge signed?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's not bury a good doorway policy in paperwork.

card.title: Conditional Command
card.instruction: Project firm authority, then soften whenever the source of that authority might be questioned.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm setting the rehearsal order. Solos first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did the director ask you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She values initiative. We could begin with your solo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need. An ensemble opening suddenly feels more inclusive.

card.title: Conditional Command
card.instruction: Project firm authority, then soften whenever the source of that authority might be questioned.

transfer.action: I tidy around {prop} before my help is requested.
transfer.opening: I found another useful thing to do here. {request}
transfer.response: There's probably a job nobody else noticed. {counter}
transfer.closing: Of course. I'll sweep while I practise believing that.

transfer.action: I display my tired hands beside {prop}.
transfer.response: Have a look at the work before deciding it's small. {counter}
transfer.closing: You can include a surface, a journey, or a number of hours.

transfer.action: I move {prop} back to its usual place and restart the sequence.
transfer.opening: First the usual step, then everything else. {request}
transfer.response: Changing the order is where things unravel. {counter}
transfer.closing: Not until this way finishes reassuring me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Test the repaired kettle, but keep the tea-shoes-keys order exactly intact.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The repair means tea takes longer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you wait beside it. I won't discover a new order by accident.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I put my shoes on first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not during testing. We need one known routine left if the kettle surprises us.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A permits a shortcut only as someone else's contained trial, retaining the routine as the baseline to protect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try the new gutter cleaner on your side before we alter our Sunday routine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually start on your side.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This is a test outside the routine, not permission to change it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's already a change.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then finish quickly so Sunday doesn't learn the difference.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A permits a shortcut only as someone else's contained trial, retaining the routine as the baseline to protect.

transfer.action: I put a spare torch and a backup battery beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: The first backup could fail too. {request}
transfer.response: I'm planning for the part nobody planned for. {counter}
transfer.closing: Which is why we shouldn't stop with this small bag.

transfer.action: I turn the inconvenience around {prop} into an occasion.
transfer.opening: A free opportunity we never planned! {request}
transfer.response: Now we can discover a better arrangement together. {counter}
transfer.closing: A remarkably productive little disaster, if we give it lunch.

transfer.action: I put a mop and tomorrow's work list beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Before we celebrate the idea, who carries it home? {request}
transfer.response: Tomorrow's cleanup is part of today's decision. {counter}
transfer.closing: Certainly. Name the cleanup crew and enjoyment can start.

transfer.action: I straighten one tiny imperfection on {prop} again.
transfer.opening: I can't concentrate while that leans. {request}
transfer.response: The beautiful parts aren't correcting this corner. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You're the only one who sees it.
transfer.closing: Then I'm carrying the entire room's share of noticing.

transfer.action: I uncover another hidden complication around {prop}.
transfer.opening: Of course the simple job has another layer. {request}
transfer.response: Put this problem beside the first five. {counter}
transfer.closing: Which is how these jobs persuade us to open the next lid.

transfer.action: I write ruling above the notes beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: That was a decision, not an invitation to debate. {request}
transfer.response: I'll record the objection as an appeal. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then the original ruling remains pleasantly unchallenged.

transfer.action: I cover the unsigned part of my authorization beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: We can settle this without checking every signature. {request}
transfer.response: I'm prepared to make a generous concession. {counter}
transfer.closing: Let's preserve the cooperative part of this conversation first.
